theme: SIP fundamentals: power of compounding, rupee cost averaging
headline: How Small Regular Investments Grow Over Time
body: Investing fixed amounts regularly helps you buy more units when prices dip, fewer when they rise. This approach smooths out market volatility naturally.
caption: Consistent investing allows your money to work through different market cycles. Over time, your returns can generate their own returns. #SIPFundamentals #RupeeCostAveraging #CompoundingPower #InvestingBasics #WealthBuilding
